Okay.' is timestamped 10:16 but actually occurs at ~10:44-10:47 (10:16 is the rep's proposal line, not the customer's confirmation) — retime or swap to a customer line actually at 10:16. Also reconcile bill_anchor_audit with the rep's actual near-flip language at 04:39 ('That's kinda how we're able to eliminate that PGE bill for you') — either acknowledge this as a weak/generic precursor to the flip that still falls short of a true customer-specific flip, or explain why it doesn't count, rather than treating 05:24 as the first and only bill-related moment. Minor: hedge the precision of the '$350 vs $390' figures given this transcript's general numeric transcription noise, and align the interest_reason_audit language with the fact that the rep never ties bill pain back to the customer at any later point in the call (not just the one generalization line at 01:41-01:47).
